% The data slice's acceptance fixture: the experience section reads @job
% records from resume-data.bib beside this file, in file order. Invented
% person and invented data — nothing from any private document.
\documentclass{resume}

\fonts{
  dir = "fonts",
  body = "Source Serif Pro",
}

\data{ file = "resume-data.bib" }

\begin{document}

{\bfseries\LARGE Alex Doe}\\
alex@example.org

\section*{Work}

\begin{foreach}{j}{job}
  \textbf{\val{j.title}}, \val{j.employer}
    \hfill \val{j.from}--\ifdata{j.to}{\val{j.to}}[present]
  \ifdata{j.unit}{\par \textit{\val{j.unit}}}
  \begin{itemize} \val{j.highlights} \end{itemize}
\end{foreach}

\end{document}
